title: Continuous uniform density gives density >0 outside of support
author: mhinne

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body:
How about passing `True` in `validate_args`? Seems to work.

```python
In [1]: from jax import numpy as jnp

In [2]: import numpyro.distributions as dist

In [3]: assert jnp.exp(dist.Uniform(0.0, 5.0, validate_args=True).log_prob(7.0)) == 0.0
<ipython-input-3-22ff8a7ff08b>:1: UserWarning: Out-of-support values provided to log prob method. The value argument should be within the support.
  assert jnp.exp(dist.Uniform(0.0, 5.0, validate_args=True).log_prob(7.0)) == 0.0
```

or globally enabling the validation.

```python
In [1]: from jax import numpy as jnp

In [2]: import numpyro.distributions as dist

In [3]: from numpyro.distributions.distribution import enable_validation

In [4]: enable_validation()

In [5]: assert jnp.exp(dist.Uniform(0.0, 5.0).log_prob(7.0)) == 0.0
<ipython-input-5-b14190ad5565>:1: UserWarning: Out-of-support values provided to log prob method. The value argument should be within the support.
  assert jnp.exp(dist.Uniform(0.0, 5.0).log_prob(7.0)) == 0.0
```
